dialogues.speaker: Yelizarov
dialogues.text: Gods, did you hear Pulcinella's proposals at the meeting? He's... he's targeting us, that's what he's doing!

dialogues.speaker: Yelizarov
dialogues.text: And he still calls himself Domovoy? He's a full head taller than any of us!

dialogues.speaker: Yelizarov
dialogues.text: If only His Majesty the Belyi Tsar were still here...

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: Even under His Majesty, we still had to pay up when it was time. What, did you think we'd be exempt?

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: Lord Pulcinella is already doing the fae nobles a courtesy by taking this to the Snezhnograd Veche.

dialogues.speaker: Yelagina
dialogues.text: And you know exactly how Her Majesty feels about fae nobles like us... You're still saying things like that out loud? Are you trying to get yourself killed?
